description: This file implements the 'TrackedObject' class, which handles tracking state and updates for objects in a computer vision application involving object detection, correlation scoring, and model matching within TensorFlow's Android testing framework.

classes.name: TrackedObject
classes.description: Represents a tracked object in video frames, maintaining position, appearance, and correlation scores, and providing methods to update tracking status based on new detections and image data.
